critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 3543 lines — extracting auth(151)/users(65)/offers(222)/admin(63) into routes/*.py is good progress but server.py remains the bulk of the codebase. Consider next: extract /search/* endpoints (search_students, search/students-nearby ~line 978-1012, 1394), the massive /seed-v3 (~line 1017-1390) into a separate seed module, and the geocoding helpers if any remain.

routes/offers.py uses register_offers_routes.enrich = _enrich_offers_with_premium (attribute on function) as a back-channel for server.py /offers-nearby — works but fragile pattern. Cleaner: move /offers-nearby into routes/offers.py too, or import _enrich_offers_with_premium from a shared util module.

routes/auth.py line 55: 'from geo_search import normalize_text as _norm' is imported inside the request handler. Fine for cold-start but worth moving to module top-level since geo_search is already a dependency.

OffersPage.jsx /offers query: when company filter is set, 4 parallel requests fire (/api/offers, /api/lba/search, /api/francetravail/search, /api/external-offers/all). Verified working but no debounce — clicking Rechercher repeatedly can spam upstreams. Consider AbortController + button-disable during fetch.
